title: Massage Seat Feature
summary: Feedback about massage seats centers on strong appreciation for comfort and massage modes, with a smaller set of complaints about missing availability or hard-to-find controls and many fragments that only mention the feature without a clear evaluative stance.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise the massage seats as enjoyable, excellent, and offering multiple massage styles.

negative.summary: Negative reviews focus on expected massage seats being absent or the massage function being difficult to locate in menus.

mixed.summary: Mixed feedback describes disappointment that a previously expected full massage seat function is no longer present.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments mention massage seats in requests, availability questions, or vague favorable references without enough detail to confirm a clear sentiment.

limitations: More than half of the topic reviews are undetermined, which limits confidence in the balance of clearly positive versus clearly negative feedback.
Several example fragments are very short or vague, and at least one assigned sentiment appears inconsistent with the fragment text, so examples are insufficient to fully characterize all mentions.
This topic includes both reactions to existing massage seats and requests or expectations for unavailable massage features, which should not be treated as a single uniform experience.
